Ancillary-Armor Augmentation.name: Decompose Helm
Ancillary-Armor Augmentation.description: Destroy a magical helmet and extract magic contraptions.

Ancillary-Armor Augmentation.name: Extract Helm Augment (Level 0-30)
Ancillary-Armor Augmentation.ingredients:
Small Helm Contraption x20
Head Armor x1
Crystal x1
Ancillary-Armor Augmentation.description:
Extract an enchantment from a helmet and turn it into an augment. This process destroys the helmet.
The chosen enchantment must be between levels 0 and 30, and will match the associated skill of the crystal you provide. You can view enchantment levels by holding Shift while viewing the item.
Note: If no enchantments match the crystal and the level requirements, you get nothing, and the item is still destroyed!

Weapon Augmentation.name: Decompose Main-Hand Weapon
Weapon Augmentation.description: Destroy a magical main-hand item and extract magic beads.

Weapon Augmentation.name: Extract Main-Hand Augment (Level 0-30)
Weapon Augmentation.ingredients:
Small Main-Hand Bead x20
Main-Hand Item x1
Crystal x1
Weapon Augmentation.description:
Extract an enchantment from a main-hand weapon and turn it into an augment. This process destroys the weapon.
The chosen enchantment must be between levels 0 and 30, and will match the associated skill of the crystal you provide. You can view enchantment levels by holding Shift while viewing the item.
Note: If no enchantments match the crystal and the level requirements, you get nothing, and the item is still destroyed!

Lore.name: Advanced Augury
Lore.description: Study the bones, organs, or body parts of a deceased creature to get a hint about your future. You may not like what you see, but the odds of a good omen are in your favor. This augury tends to have more potent futures -- both good and ill -- than the Basic Augury. It is also more sensitive to the body part used, with more possible outcomes for certain parts.

Lore.ingredients:
Glamour Berry x1
Item to Glamour x1
Item to Copy Appearance From x1
Lore.description:
Makes one piece of equipment permanently look like another piece of equipment.
The glamoured item will have the same dye coloration as the item it's copied from. You cannot re-dye a glamoured item.
If the new appearance is specific to an animal form (e.g. werewolf armor), the glamour only applies when worn in that animal form.

Etch the magical rune for deer onto a malachite, so that it is attuned to only that species when used in crafting recipes.
* In-game, this recipe is displayed under Lore.

Sigil Scripting.name: Fairy Magic Inscription
Sigil Scripting.description:
Etch the magical rune for fairy magic onto a topaz, so that it has a chance to yield fairy magic powers when used in crafting recipes.
* In-game, this recipe is displayed under Lore.

Teleportation.name: (Fae Only) Mushroom-Circle Bind
Teleportation.description: Ties your soul to a particular mushroom circle so that you can return via Teleportation magic. You must be standing in a mushroom circle. Costs 10 Fae Energy.

Teleportation.name: (Fae Only) Mushroom-Circle Recall
Teleportation.description: Returns you to the mushroom circle that you're tied to. You must be in a mushroom circle. Costs 10 Fae Energy and can be cast once per 30 minutes.

Teleportation.name: (Fae Only) Recall Beginnings
Teleportation.description: Teleports you to the entrance of the area you're currently in.

Teleportation.name: (Fae Only) Return to Fae Realm
Teleportation.description: While standing in a mushroom circle, return to the fae realm. Can be cast once per 15 minutes.

Teleportation.name: Bind Circle
Teleportation.description: Ties your soul to a particular Teleportation Circle so that you can return to it via Teleportation magic. You must be standing on a Teleportation Circle.

Teleportation.name: Recall Beginnings (Hardcore)
Teleportation.description: Teleports you to the entrance of the area you're currently in.

Teleportation.name: Recall Gazluk Animal Camp
Teleportation.description: Teleports you to the animal camp in Gazluk. Can be used once per hour.

Teleportation.name: Recall Serbule Docks
Teleportation.description: Teleports you to the Serbule docks. Can be used once per hour.

Teleportation.name: Return to Guild Hall
Teleportation.description: Teleports you back to wherever your guild's home position is set to. Costs 2 Guild Credits. (Note: currently all guilds' home positions are in Rahu, but eventually they will be able to pick from different cities.)
